name: Gravity Sword
description: A heavy squared slab of gunmetal with a cold white core seam and a flat chisel end rather than a point — a hammer that happens to have an edge. The guard is a plain bronze bar straight across, the only horizontal guard in the collection, over a short grip and a dense counterweight pommel. Entirely achromatic apart from the bronze, so it can never be mistaken for the Void Sword's indigo and cyan.
